desc:
BigCommerce SEO and page speed fixes make your store quicker to load and easier for search engines to read. Ecom Swift LLC tests your key pages, shrinks heavy images, removes unused scripts and fixes titles, headings, redirects and markup.

## What are BigCommerce SEO and page speed fixes?

They are practical changes to your store that help pages load faster and help search engines understand what each page is about. Speed work targets images, scripts and apps. SEO work targets page titles, descriptions, headings, sitemaps, redirects and product markup.

The two belong together. A slow page frustrates shoppers and weakens the experience search engines try to reward. A fast page with a muddled title still struggles to be found.

## Why speed and search setup often get ignored

Stores grow by addition. A new app here, a banner image there, a tracking script for a campaign that ended months ago. Each addition is small, but together they weigh pages down. Meanwhile product titles stay as supplier codes and descriptions stay empty, because nobody had time to write them.

The result is a store that feels heavy on a phone and tells search engines very little. Neither problem hurts loudly. They simply cost you visitors and sales without leaving any obvious trace.

## How these fixes help results

Faster pages let shoppers reach products and checkout sooner, and fewer people give up while waiting. Clear titles and descriptions help search engines match your pages with what people type. Clean headings and structured product markup make it easier for engines to read price and availability.

Broken links and bad redirects waste visits. Fixing them keeps shoppers moving and preserves the authority your pages have built. We can improve the technical condition of your store, but we cannot promise rankings, since competitors, content and search engines all influence the outcome.

## What this project includes

- Speed tests of your most important pages, before and after.
- Image compression and sensible sizing for those pages.
- Removal of scripts and apps your store no longer needs.
- Page titles and meta descriptions written for products and categories.
- Heading structure fixed, so each page has one clear main heading.
- A sitemap and robots file check.
- Broken link and redirect repairs.
- A product markup check so price and stock can be read by search engines.
- Duplicate content and canonical tag fixes, in the deeper package.
- Image alt text, a keyword map for main categories and a month of tracking tasks, in the deeper package.

## How we run the project

We test your key pages first and record the results, so there is a clear starting point. We then inspect the theme, the installed apps and the scripts loading on each page to see what is slowing things down. Before removing anything, we check what it does, so no working feature breaks.

Next we work through the search setup: titles, descriptions, headings and redirects. Basic covers a focused pass on your top pages and ten product titles. Standard handles sitewide speed fixes with category and product SEO. Premium adds a deep technical clean-up, a keyword map and a handover. You receive a before and after comparison plus a plain list of every change.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us which categories and products matter most.
- Keep one clear main heading on every page.
- Write titles that describe the product the way shoppers search for it.
- Compress images before uploading new ones.
- Review installed apps every few months.

**Avoid:**
- Stuffing the same keyword into every title.
- Copying manufacturer descriptions word for word.
- Uploading full-size camera photos.
- Leaving old tracking scripts running.
- Changing page addresses without a redirect.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store that feels slow on mobile, an owner whose product titles are still supplier codes, and a seller who plans to invest in content or ads and wants the technical base sound first.

## What we need from you

Your store address, a list of your main categories and products, and any keywords you already target. We never need your password. You add us as a staff user with the permissions the work needs. Access to Google Search Console is helpful but optional, and we can set it up for you if you do not have it.
